test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

K P _ L Z _ P _ MZK _ B _ Z _ PB _ Z

options.text: B K B P N P O
B K B P N K O
B K B P N K P
B K P P O K P

solution:
**Given:** 

K P _ L Z _ P _ MZK _ B _ Z _ PB _ Z

Let's check each option:

1) B K B P N P O → K P **__B__** /L Z/ **__K__** P __B/__ MZ/K __P__ B /**__N__** Z/ __P__ PB /__O__ Z

**2) B K B P N K O** → K P __B__ /L Z /__K__ P __B__ /MZ/K __P__ B /__N__ Z /__K__ PB /__O__ Z

So, In option 2 "KPB - L/M/N/O - Z" is repeating itself.

3) B K B P N K P → K P __B__ /L Z/ __K__ P __B/__ MZ/K __P__ B/ __N__ Z/ __K__ PB/ __P__ Z

4) B K P P O K P → K P __B__ /L Z/ __K__ P __P__/MZ/K __P__ B/ **__O__** Z /__K__ PB/ **__P__** Z

Hence, ‘B K B P N K O’ is the correct answer.
